Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 11-G at 4655-4657 N
                              Broadway - App No. 22135T1
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                    ORDINANCE
                                                                     M/)W) 15,

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping District,
as shown on Map 11 -G in the area bounded by:

West Leiand Avenue; the alley next east of North Broadway Avenue; a line 5,050
feet Northwest of the intersection of North Broadway Avenue and West Wilson
Avenue as measured along the East right-of-way line of North Broadway Avenue
and perpendicular thereto; and North Broadway Avenue,

to those of B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.
                                    NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                                  FOR THE PROPOSED TYPE 1
                                      ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
                           4655-4567 NORTH BROADWAY AVENUE

         The Applicauon on behalf of the Applicant and Contract Purchaser, Wemi Properties, LLC, is for
a Zoning Map Amendment from B3-2 Community Shopping District to B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use
District for purposes of adaptive re-use and construction of additional stories which mixed-use Building
will contain twenty-four (24) dwelling unit building with two (2) ground floor Retail spaces. The
Application is tiled under 17-13-()302-A as a Type 1 filing.

        The footprint of the building is irregular and shall be approximately 77.10 by 62.77 and 72.17 by
95.16. The building height shall be 65 feet, as defined by City Code.

SPECIFIC CRITERIA FOR THIS EQUITABLE TRANSIT SERVED LOCATION

        Under Section 17-3-0308 any new construction or rehabilitation or reuse of existing structures
withing 2,640 feet of a CTA or METILV rail station entrance must satisfy all of the following criteria (the
proposed is a twentyr-four (24) dwelling unit mixed use, adaptive re-use and partial new construction
Building:

        1. The Project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B, located 680 feet south of the Lawrence
           Avenue Red-Line Station and adjacent to the Broadway #36 CTA Bus route; will seek an
           administrative adjustment.
        2. The site is not a Pedestrian Street under 17-3-0504; (non-accessory parking abutting a
           Pedestrian Street is not applicable);
        3. The Project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development
           Guide since it is located in a Local Activity Center Area as an in-till development and both on
           a quaHtied CTA Bus route and in close proximity to the Red Line;
        4. The proposed mixed-use Project currently contains no off-street parking and none will be
           provided under the Proposal;
        5. The Project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the
           Chicago Department of Transportation.

SITE DETAIL

        a. Lot Area:                                   6,025 square feet
        b. Floor Area Ratio:                           4.39
           (Retail Space is 6.025 square feet)
        c. Building Area:                              26,465.00
        d. Minimum Lot Area per Dwelling Unit: 251.04 square feet
        e. Off-Strcet Parking:                         None currently or intended to be provided, the
           site is 680 feet south of the CTA Lawrence Red Line entrance and on the Broadway #36 CTA
           Bus route (** Applicant will seek relief under Section 17-3-0308-B as an Equitable
           Transit Served Location**);
        f. Front Setback:                              0 foot
        g. Rear Setback:                               9.0 feet (at new Residential levels)
        h. Side Setback:                               Three (3) feet on south at new residential levels
        i. Building Height:                            65 feet
